request.curl:
curl -sS -X POST 'https://api.supplier.example/v1/chat/completions' \
  -H 'accept: */*' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SUPGATE_KEY' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-5.4","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Count from 1 to 50."}],"max_tokens":64,"stream":true,"stream_options":{"include_usage":true},"temperature":0}'
